Welcome to ShrimpFarm

We value your privacy. Before using this app, please understand:

This app needs network permission for login, backup, and market prices; storage permission for local backup. We do NOT collect IMEI, location, contacts, or sensitive data. No ad SDKs included.

To provide our service, we need to:
Use your email for account registration & login
Store your farming data encrypted on your device
Back up data to your WebDAV account on your choice
Fetch market prices and other public info from the network
